title: WS-018 - Results API overview
intent: Explain how to export survey results through the EUSurvey Web-services API.
short_answer: The Results API allows a system user to prepare and download survey results in XML, PDF, or combined packages. Result preparation is asynchronous: first call a prepareResultsXXX endpoint to receive a ticket, then poll getResults until the prepared file is available. Result extraction requires Results read-only access on the survey.
procedure: Grant the system user Results RO on the survey.
Choose the export format: XML, PDF, combined XML/PDF/uploaded files, single token, or single contribution ID.
Poll getResults with the ticket returned by the prepare endpoint.
Download and process the ZIP, XML or PDF result according to the endpoint output format.
important_conditions: All prepareResultsXXX actions support an optional hook parameter that EUSurvey calls when the asynchronous export is finished.
Only the original requesting user can download the prepared data.
